status: Preliminary derived table from complete official cells; full report finalization pending.
definition: Latency is mean of seed 0,1,2 per-seed medians from 200 measured repeats following 50 warmups. Speedup is mean of paired raw/gray60 seed median ratios, not ratio of means. Metrics use completed official clean+15 MNIST-C or75 CIFAR10-C cells. Cached-input model-only is a separately measured diagnostic, not a subtractable stage. Same frozen GPU/CPU/thread class can span physical devices.
validation: Detailed separate audit passed 48 parent accuracy runs,96 timing workers,4416 cell-summary hashes,1104 paired input panels,96 hardware-session hashes/contract identities. This table retains24 official clean B1 cell source hashes; no large raw timing, prediction or checkpoint file was rehashed in this bounded live audit.
metric_notes: Final train_online is accumulated during last training epoch (augmented CIFAR inputs and evolving model), not a frozen clean train-set evaluation. Validation is final heldout-val epoch,5000 images. MNIST-C has brightness/fog fixed corruptions, no contrast cell; CIFAR-C corruption values equally average all5severities. mCE is unnormalized mean corruption error. Accuracy percents, cross-entropy losses dimensionless.
